mtrpoint.tip_length: Multiplier of automatic coverage; default 0.9. Internal scissors seams are coordinated automatically.
mtrpoint.tip_blade: Distance from blade tip to full rail section, in metres. 0 calculates it automatically.
mtrpoint.tip_throw: Lateral blade travel between the two positions, in metres.
mtrpoint.tip_flangeway: Clear space for wheel flanges between wing and nose rails, in metres.
mtrpoint.tip_spacing: Distance between consecutive sleeper centres, in metres.
mtrpoint.tip_sleeper_width: Sleeper width along the track, in metres. This does not set its span across the rails.
mtrpoint.tip_overhang: Sleeper extension beyond the outermost rail, in metres.
mtrpoint.tip_gauge: Distance between inside rail faces, in metres. 0 uses the active profile.
mtrpoint.tip_rail_top: Rail-top height above the track reference, in metres. 0 uses the profile; not world altitude.
mtrpoint.tip_head_width: Nominal rail-head width, in metres. 0 uses the active profile.
mtrpoint.tip_height: Move the entire model vertically, in metres. Positive raises; negative lowers.
mtrpoint.tip_frog_shift: Shift the frog along branches, in metres. Positive moves away from the blade tips.
mtrpoint.tip_duration: Duration of a full visual throw, in seconds. Default 1; does not change train logic.
mtrpoint.tip_sleeper_angle: Start offset from automatic sleeper orientation, in degrees. Applies throughout in parallel mode.
mtrpoint.tip_sleeper_end_angle: End angle, in degrees. Blends from the start in linear, smooth or V modes.
mtrpoint.tip_sleeper_mode: Choose curve-following, parallel, linear, smooth, or V arms perpendicular to each branch.
mtrpoint.tip_guard_shift: Shift the check rail along the track in metres; positive moves away from blade tips.
mtrpoint.tip_guard_length: Length added to the automatic check rail, in metres. Negative shortens; 0 keeps automatic.
mtrpoint.tip_guard_gap: Extra check rail flangeway width in metres. Positive widens; 0 uses the base gap.
mtrpoint.tip_wing_shift: Shift the wing rail along the track in metres; positive moves away from blade tips.
mtrpoint.tip_wing_length: Length added to the automatic wing rail, in metres. Negative shortens; 0 keeps automatic.
mtrpoint.tip_wing_gap: Extra wing rail flangeway width in metres. Positive widens; 0 uses the base gap.
mtrpoint.tip_nose_length: Extra nose/heart rail length after the crossing, in metres. Negative shortens; 0 keeps automatic.
